_doc: Which skill docs an agent pays for in every session. 'always': the SKILL.md body, and every doc the SKILL.md tells the
agent to read unconditionally (the quoted instruction is the reason). 'conditional': read on a trigger. A doc under skills/
that is in neither list is reported as 'unclassified' (counted as conditional) so a PR that adds one has to place it here.
role: which agents load the skill (designer covers the v2 planner, builders and finish agents; reviewer the review agent).

always.skills/print-cad-blender/reference/api.m: SKILL.md Reference: 'Read it before writing the first part'
always.skills/print-cad-blender/reference/footg: SKILL.md Reference: 'Read it before declaring a subsystem done'
always.skills/cad-design-review/checklist.md: SKILL.md step 5: 'Walk the checklist in checklist.md'

conditional.skills/print-cad-blender/reference/check: SKILL.md Reference: 'Read it when cadcheck flags something you designed on purpose'
conditional.skills/print-cad-blender/reference/desig: SKILL.md Reference: 'Worth reading when you choose it for a new project'
conditional.skills/print-cad-blender/reference/snaps: SKILL.md Joining: read when a part snaps or hinges in place
SKILL.md tool table: read when making or debugging a cad view page
SKILL.md tool table: read when a cad diff / cad check delta line is unclear
